name: opterite
description: Opterite — bulk email platform. Node/Express API in backend/, React SPA in frontend/.
//: Scripts only: this package has no dependencies of its own. It exists so the repository root keeps working entry points now that the backend lives in backend/ — `npm start` and `npm test` at the root used to run the server and its suite. Each app keeps its own package.json and lockfile; npm workspaces are deliberately not used, because hoisting a shared node_modules would change module resolution for a backend that currently has none of that complexity.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
